scripts.bundle:web: set -a && . ./.env.development && set +a && env APP_VARIANT=development npx expo export --platform web --clear
scripts.bundle:web:prod: set -a && . ./.env.local && . ./.env.production && set +a && npx expo export --platform web --clear
scripts.build:web:pages: APP_VARIANT=production npx expo export --platform web --clear && node scripts/prepare-web-deploy.cjs
scripts.compile: pnpm run compile:app && pnpm run compile:test
scripts.export:check: expo export --platform ios --platform android --platform web --output-dir dist-export-check
scripts.depcruise:graph: depcruise src convex --include-only "^(src|convex)" --config .dependency-cruiser.js --output-type dot > app-dependency-graph.dot && dot -T svg app-dependency-graph.dot -o app-dependency-graph.svg && dot -T png app-dependency-graph.dot -o app-dependency-graph.png && rm app-dependency-graph.dot
scripts.check:ygo-worker: wrangler types --check --cwd workers/ygo-image-mirror && tsc --noEmit -p workers/ygo-image-mirror/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p workers/ygo-image-mirror/sync/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p workers/ygo-image-mirror/test/tsconfig.json && pnpm test:ygo-worker && wrangler deploy --dry-run --cwd workers/ygo-image-mirror --env= --outdir .wrangler/dry-run-preview && wrangler deploy --dry-run --cwd workers/ygo-image-mirror --env production --outdir .wrangler/dry-run-production
scripts.adb: adb reverse tcp:9090 tcp:9090 && adb reverse tcp:3000 tcp:3000 && adb reverse tcp:9001 tcp:9001 && adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081
scripts.build:ios:sim: env APP_VARIANT=development npx eas-cli@latest build --profile development --platform ios --local
scripts.build:ios:dev: env APP_VARIANT=development npx eas-cli@latest build --profile development:device --platform ios --local
scripts.build:ios:prod: set -a && . ./.env.local && . ./.env.production && set +a && npx eas-cli@latest build --profile production --platform ios --local
scripts.build:android:sim: env APP_VARIANT=development npx eas-cli@latest build --profile development --platform android --local
scripts.build:android:dev: env APP_VARIANT=development npx eas-cli@latest build --profile development:device --platform android --local
scripts.build:android:prod: set -a && . ./.env.local && . ./.env.production && set +a && npx eas-cli@latest build --profile production --platform android --local
